claims.text: OCHA's oPt Humanitarian Situation Report (23 July 2026) states: 'Fatalities linked to settler attacks in 2026 have already surpassed the total recorded during all of 2025, with 18 Palestinians killed as of 20 July compared with 17 throughout 2025,' and 'about 90 Palestinians were displaced by demolitions and settler attacks during the reporting period, most following a large-scale demolition carried out by Israeli authorities in a Bedouin community in Qalqiliya governorate.'

OCHA's oPt Humanitarian Situation Report (7 August 2026, reporting period 28 July-3 August) states: "During the reporting period, no Palestinian fatalities were reported in the West Bank. At least 37 Palestinians were injured by Israeli forces or Israeli settlers, and 35 settler attacks that resulted in casualties, property damage, or both were documented." This is a weekly update; it does not restate the cumulative 2026 totals (76 Palestinians and 3 Israelis killed) already on file, which remain unchanged.

OCHA oPt's Humanitarian Situation Report covering 28 July-3 August 2026 (published 6 August 2026) states that 'during the reporting period, no Palestinian fatalities were reported in the West Bank,' while at least 37 Palestinians were injured by Israeli forces or settlers and 35 settler attacks resulting in casualties and/or property damage were documented that week. A separate OCHA oPt report dated 31 July 2026 gives a cumulative 2026 toll of 76 Palestinians 'killed by Israeli forces or settlers or died of wounds sustained earlier' and approximately 2,300 people displaced since the start of 2026 due to settler attacks or access restrictions -- both broader-scope, cumulative figures that do not exactly match this record's existing deaths/displaced counts, so the recorded totals are retained pending reconciliation of scope.

UN Security Council briefing by Ramiz Alakbarov, Deputy Special Coordinator for the Middle East Peace Process (11 August 2026): 'So far in 2026, 76 Palestinians have been killed in the West Bank by Israeli forces or settlers, including 18 children. Three Israelis were killed in confrontations with Palestinians.' 'Some 3,800 Palestinians, nearly half of them children, were displaced due to settler violence, demolitions and evictions.'

OCHA oPt Humanitarian Situation Report (14 August 2026, covering 4-10 August): 38 incidents involving Israeli settlers resulted in Palestinian casualties and/or property damage; in Masafer Yatta, about 30 settlers attacked the Tuba community, injuring 5 and destroying 3 residential structures by fire (displacing 3 families, 23 people including 14 children); near Beit Furik/Beit Dajan, four attacks (6-8 August) injured 7 Palestinians; settlers attacked a Palestine Red Crescent Society team near Abu Njeim on 7 August, injuring 4 including 2 paramedics.

The same OCHA oPt report documents an Israeli forces operation in Qalandiya Camp injuring 51 Palestinians (44 physically assaulted including a 9-year-old, one hit by a rubber-coated metal bullet, six treated for tear gas inhalation) and demolishing 9 structures (displacing 13 households, 71 people including 31 children); West Bank-wide, 25 Palestinian-owned structures were demolished between 8-10 August, displacing 6 households (29 people, including 17 children).

Human Rights Watch (hosted on ReliefWeb): 'Two Israeli settler attacks on Tal village near Nablus in the West Bank on July 24, 2026, resulted in the killing of four Palestinians and two Israelis... The July 24 killings in Tal bring the Palestinian death toll in the occupied West Bank since July 19 to 10.' The incident triggered a wave of settler reprisal attacks on nearby Palestinian villages and the Israeli government's announcement of a 'major counterterrorism operation.'

Per the same ReliefWeb-hosted Human Rights Watch report: 'As of July 19, the United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA) reported 68 Palestinians killed in the West Bank in 2026, at least 13 by settlers. OCHA reported that as of July 15, 20 Israelis had been injured in 2026 in the West Bank.'

UN News, citing OHCHR and OCHA (29 July 2026): 'As of 24 July, the agency reports that 76 Palestinians and one Israeli have died this year in settler attacks... Since Friday, eight Palestinians, including a boy, and two members of the Israeli military have also been killed in the region.' 'The number of settler attacks has increased each year since 2023... rising to 1,835 last year.' 'There were about 190 attacks per month in the first four months of 2026, putting the West Bank on a trajectory to reach more than 2,000 attacks by the end of the year.' 'Nearly 700 Palestinians in nine communities in the West Bank were displaced as a result of settler attacks in the first four months of 2026.'

UN News (29 July 2026), citing OHCHR and OCHA: 'As of 24 July, the agency reports that 76 Palestinians and one Israeli have died this year in settler attacks... Since Friday, eight Palestinians, including a boy, and two members of the Israeli military have also been killed in the region.' The article describes West Bank settler violence as having hit an 'all-time high.' It also reconfirms OCHA's separate figure that 18 Palestinians died in 2026 as of 20 July in attacks involving settlers (12 by settlers, 3 by Israeli forces, 3 disputed responsibility), and repeats the 'nearly 700 Palestinians across nine communities' displacement figure for the first four months of 2026.

OCHA's 'oPt: Humanitarian Situation Report | 31 July 2026' (posted to ReliefWeb 3 August 2026) states, for the West Bank section covering 21-27 July: 'the reporting period was marked by a series of deadly incidents that resulted in the killing of eight Palestinians and two members of Israeli forces, including a settlement security guard... July matching March 2026 as the deadliest month for Palestinians in settler attacks since October 2023.' It further states: 'Since the beginning of 2026, 76 Palestinians have been killed by Israeli forces or settlers or died of wounds sustained earlier, and three Israelis, including the two members of Israeli forces mentioned above, have been killed by Palestinians in the West Bank. More than 1,600 Palestinians have also been injured, including 46 per cent by Israeli settlers and the remainder by Israeli forces, while 24 Israelis, including 20 settlers and two soldiers, have been injured.' And: 'Since the beginning of 2026, more than 1,380 settler-related incidents have been documented, affecting over 250 Palestinian communities and averaging about 6.6 incidents per day... about 900 Palestinians were injured in the context of settler attacks... while more than 2,300 Palestinians were displaced due to settler attacks and related access restrictions.' It also states demolitions, settler violence and access restrictions 'have displaced an average of 17 people, including eight children, per day in 2026 - double the daily average recorded over the preceding three years.'

description: A sharp escalation of Israeli settler violence in the occupied West Bank culminated on 24 July 2026, when Israeli settlers carried out two attacks on Tal village near Nablus that left four Palestinians and two Israelis dead and triggered a wave of reprisal attacks on nearby Palestinian villages and an Israeli government-announced 'major counterterrorism operation.' OCHA has documented more than 1,380 settler-related incidents since the start of 2026, affecting over 250 Palestinian communities, and assesses July as, jointly with March 2026, the deadliest month for Palestinians in settler-related incidents since October 2023. A UN Security Council briefing on 11 August 2026 put the cumulative 2026 toll at 76 Palestinians, including 18 children, and 3 Israelis killed in the West Bank, with some 3,800 Palestinians, nearly half of them children, displaced by settler violence, demolitions and evictions. OCHA's latest weekly report, published 14 August 2026, documented 38 settler attacks resulting in casualties or property damage in the week of 4-10 August, and the violence continues.

impact.summary: Per an 11 August 2026 UN Security Council briefing, 76 Palestinians, including 18 children, and 3 Israelis have been killed in the West Bank since the start of 2026, and some 3,800 Palestinians, nearly half of them children, have been displaced by settler violence, demolitions and evictions. OCHA has documented more than 1,380 settler-related incidents affecting over 250 Palestinian communities — about 6.6 per day — with more than 1,600 Palestinians injured, and July was, jointly with March 2026, the deadliest month for Palestinians in settler-related incidents since October 2023. OCHA's 14 August 2026 weekly report recorded 38 further settler attacks resulting in casualties or property damage between 4 and 10 August.

updates.text: OCHA's weekly report of 14 August documented 38 settler attacks causing casualties or property damage over 4-10 August, including an attack by about 30 settlers on the Tuba community in Masafer Yatta that destroyed 3 homes and displaced 23 people, and an Israeli forces operation in Qalandiya Camp that injured 51 Palestinians and demolished 9 structures, displacing 71 people.

A UN Security Council briefing put 2026 displacement at some 3,800 Palestinians, nearly half of them children, due to settler violence, demolitions and evictions — up from the roughly 2,300 OCHA had reported as of 31 July — and confirmed the toll of 76 Palestinians and 3 Israelis killed.

OCHA's weekly report of 7 August recorded no Palestinian fatalities in the West Bank for 28 July-3 August, with at least 37 Palestinians injured and 35 settler attacks resulting in casualties or property damage.

OCHA's situation report of 31 July consolidated the 2026 toll: 76 Palestinians and three Israelis killed, more than 1,600 Palestinians injured, more than 2,300 displaced by settler attacks and related access restrictions, and 1,380+ settler-related incidents — superseding OHCHR's narrower count of 76 Palestinians and one Israeli killed in settler attacks with nearly 700 displaced.

UN News, citing OHCHR and OCHA, described West Bank settler violence as at an all-time high: 76 Palestinians and one Israeli killed in settler attacks as of 24 July, about 190 attacks per month in the first four months of 2026, and nearly 700 Palestinians displaced across nine communities.
